caption:
Soon some of your customers won't call you. Their AI assistant will.

AI agents that search, compare and book services on someone's behalf are already being built by the biggest tech companies. "Find me a detailer this Saturday under $200" is a request an assistant will handle end to end.

That assistant won't wait for a callback. It will pick the business it can understand and book fastest.

What makes you "bookable by a bot":
→ Clear services and starting prices written on your site
→ Online booking or a simple quote form
→ Hours, service area and contact info that match everywhere
→ Recent reviews it can read

The businesses that get ready early will look like magic to the customer.

Would you trust an AI to book a service for you? Tell me in the comments.
